entities.summary: Michael Chaput is a Canadian former professional ice hockey player. He was selected in the third round, 89th overall, by the Philadelphia Flyers of the National Hockey League (NHL) in the 2010 NHL entry draft and played for the Columbus Blue Jackets, Vancouver Canucks, Montreal Canadiens, and Arizona Coyotes.
